verses: Yaqeenan guzra hai insan per aik waqt zamaney mein jab kay yeh koi qabil zikar cheez na tha
Be-shak hum ney insan ko milay julay nutfay say imtehan kay liye peda kiya aur uss ko sunta dekhta banaya
Hum ney ussay raah dikhaee abb khuwah woh shukar guzaar banay khuwah nashukra
Yaqeenan hum ney kafiron kay liye zanjeeren aur toq aur sholon wali aag tayyar ker rakhi hai
Be-shak nek log woh jam piyein gay jiss ki amezish kafiron ki hai
Jo aik chashma hai. Jiss say Allah kay banday piyein gay uss ki nehren nikal ley jayen gay (jidhar chahayen)
Jo nazar poori kertay hain aur uss din say dartay hain jiss ki buraee charon taraf phel janey wali hai
Aur Allah Taalaa ki mohabbat mein khana khilatay hain miskeen, yateem aur qaidiyon ko
Hum to tumhen sirf Allah Taalaa ki razamandi kay liye khilatay hain na tum say badla chahatay hain na shukar guzari
Be-shak hum apney perwerdigar say uss din ka khof kertay hain jo udasi aur sakhti wala hoga
Pus unhen Allah Taalaa ney uss din ki buraee say bacha liya aur unhen taazgi aur khushi phonchaee
Aur unhen unn kay sabar kay badlay jannat aur reshmi libas ata farmaye
Yeh o haan takhton per takiey lagaye huye bethen gay. Na o haan aftab ki garmi dekhen gay na jaray ki sakhti
Unn jannaton kay saye unn per jhukay huye hun gay aur unn kay (meway aur) guchhay neechay latkaaey huye hun gay
Aur unn per chandi kay bartano aur unn jaamon ka door keraya jaye ga jo sheeshay kay hun gay
Sheeshay bhi chandi kay jin ko (saqi ney) andazay say naap rakha hoga
Aur unhen o haan woh jam pilaye jayen gay jin ki amezish zanjabeel ki hogi
Jannat ki aik nehar say jiss ka naam salsabeel hai
Aur unn kay ird gird ghoomtey phirtay hun gay woh kum sunn bachay jo hamesha rehney walay hain jab to unhen dekhay to samajh kay woh bikhray huye sachay moti hain
To o haan jahan kahen bhi nazar dalay ga sirasir nematen aur azeem azeem-ul-shaan saltanat hi dekhay ga
Unn kay jismoon per sabz bareek aur motay reshmi kapray hun gay aur unhen chandi kay kanggan ka zewar pehnaya jaye ga. Aur unhen unn ka rab pak saaf sharab pilaye ga
(kaha jaye ga) kay yeh hai tumharay aemaal ka badla aur tumhari koshish ki qadar ki gaee
Be-shak hum ney tujh per ba-tadreej Quran nazil kiya hai
Pus to apney rab kay hukum per qaeem reh aur unn mein say kissi gunehgar ya na-shukray ka kaha na maan
Aur apney rab kay naam ka subha o shaam zikar kiya ker
Aur raat kay waqt uss kay samney sajday ker aur boht raat tak uss ki tasbeeh kiya ker
Be-shak yeh log jaldi milney wali (duniya) ko chahatay hain aur apney peechay aik baray bhari din ko choray detay hain
Hum ney unhen peda kiya aur hum ney hi unn kay jor aur bandhan mazboot kiye aur hum jab chahayen unn kay ewaz unn jaisay auron ko badal layen
Yaqeenan yeh to aik naseehat hai pus jo chahaye apney rab ki raah ley ley
Aur tum na chahao gay magar yeh kay Allah Taalaa hi chahaye be-shak Allah Taalaa ilm wala ba-hikmat hai
Jissay chahaye apni rehmat mein dakhil kerley, aur zalimon kay liye uss ney dard-naak azab tayyar ker rakha hai
